entry.title: build(repo): make cloud sessions able to run the project's own commands
entry.content:
build(repo): make cloud sessions able to run the project's own commands

A Claude Code cloud session started on an image whose Node predates `.nvmrc`, with no installed
dependencies and a Playwright browser of the wrong build behind a blocked download CDN, so neither
the test suites nor the browser lane could run at all. A SessionStart hook now selects the pinned
Node, installs `web` dependencies when the clone has none, and points Playwright at the browser the
sandbox does provide; it is inert locally and a no-op once the environment's setup script, kept
here as a reference copy, has put the same things in the cached snapshot.

The browser override is read from an environment variable the hook sets only when the pinned build
is genuinely absent, so CI and local runs resolve their own browser unchanged.

entry.content:

entry.title: feat(repo): make the wide header a site header with a home mark
entry.content:
feat(repo): make the wide header a site header with a home mark

On a wide screen the Monosai mark and wordmark are the link home, so the header drops its Home tab;
Library, Settings and Help follow as labelled places, and the current one is marked by a rule on
the bar's edge rather than a filled pill. On a phone the docked tabs are unchanged and Home's Help
gains its label. Recorded in ADR 0071, which amends ADR 0070.

entry.title: feat(repo): keep one site header across the tab pages on desktop
entry.content:
feat(repo): keep one site header across the tab pages on desktop

On a wide screen Home, Library and Settings now wear the same bar, the way a website does: the
Monosai mark and wordmark, then Home, Library and Settings at the bar's end, then Help. The tabs were
centred and the brand and Help appeared on Home alone, so the header looked different on every tab.
Phones keep their bottom tab bar and Home-only Help, and Help's Back returns to the tab that opened
it.

entry.title: test(repo): cover tab navigation between home, library and settings
entry.content:
test(repo): cover tab navigation between home, library and settings

A new smoke journey opens on Home, switches between the three tabs with aria-current following, starts
either kind of story in one tap, and leaves the reader without a tab bar, on desktop and Android.
Existing journeys now land on Home, start stories from its direct links, reach the shelf through the
Library tab, and go back to Home from Paste text, Write with AI and a story opened there. The two
pages below Words and level lose their last "what you can read" label.

entry.title: fix(pwa): keep status bar icons readable in the installed app
entry.content:
fix(pwa): keep status bar icons readable in the installed app

Installed Android apps paint the status bar from the manifest colour but choose icon contrast
from the page's theme-color. Following the theme at runtime left dark icons on the dark bar in
light mode, so theme-color now stays at the manifest's dark value and the runtime sync is gone.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

entry.title: fix(pwa): darken the installed app's status bar under a dark system
entry.content:
fix(pwa): darken the installed app's status bar under a dark system

Chrome on Android ignores theme-color for installed apps while the system is dark and falls
back to the manifest colour, so the manifest now carries the dark canvas. In a light system the
page's theme-color still wins and keeps the bar light.
